permit.quote: send marketing communications via SMS, process transactions with partners, share data with Hilton’s Third-Party Partner, authenticate mobile accounts, send service-related SMS communications, detect and prevent fraud, and engage in sales activities for group bookings

prohibit.quote: We will not use your phone number for telemarketing.

conflicts.situation: A French resident gives a phone number at booking, and Hilton uses it to send SMS marketing or to pursue group-booking sales.
conflicts.reason: The same French appendix paragraph lists SMS marketing and group-booking sales as phone-number uses, then says the number will not be used for telemarketing. It does not define telemarketing or exclude texts or sales calls.

permit.quote: We may disclose to parties outside ColorNote Data and information about you that we collect when we have a good faith belief that disclosure is reasonably necessary to (a) comply with a law, regulation or compulsory legal request; (b) protect the safety of any person from death or serious bodily injury; (c) prevent fraud or abuse of ColorNote or its users; or (d) to protect ColorNote’s property rights.

prohibit.quote: We cannot view it unless you expressly give us permission or it’s necessary to comply with our legal obligations.

conflicts.situation: ColorNote discloses a user's stored notes to an outside party to prevent fraud or protect its property rights, without the user's permission or a legal obligation.
conflicts.reason: The Data section allows access only with permission or for legal obligations. The disclosure clause adds fraud, safety, and property grounds. Neither statement refers to the other or says which governs.

permit.quote: Opt out of sales of personal information. To opt out of receiving interest-based advertising, you can exercise your choice by using your settings.

prohibit.quote: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

conflicts.situation: A California user's identifiers and usage data are used for interest-based advertising through third parties.
conflicts.reason: The policy states it does not sell personal information, yet the California rights treat opting out of interest-based advertising as opting out of sales. The policy does not reconcile the two statements.

permit.quote: may be combined with any of the above information

prohibit.quote: Such information will only be used to provide you with support services and will not be connected with any other information collected from you on or through the Software and Services, including, any individual User ID (as defined below) generated or collected by us.

conflicts.situation: A user emails support, and the Company holds both the support information and the automatically generated User ID for that user.
conflicts.reason: The support paragraph says support information will not be connected with the User ID. The next sentence says the User ID may be combined with any of the above information, which includes support information.

permit.quote: The purposes of the support related information is: (i) to take any action in case of a dispute involving you in connection with the Software and Services

prohibit.quote: Such information will only be used to provide you with support services

conflicts.situation: The Company uses the contents of a user's support request in a dispute with that user or to enforce its terms.
conflicts.reason: The support paragraph limits support information to providing support services. The stated purposes for the same information add disputes, enforcement, and legal compliance. No exception links the two statements.

permit.quote: This information may include friends or contact lists, notes, updates, and photos and may be used by the Company to customize the content available to you through the Software and Services

prohibit.quote: While it is not our intention to collect any personally identifiable information

conflicts.situation: A user activates the social network feature, and the Company compiles the user's friend lists and photos.
conflicts.reason: The policy says it does not intend to collect PII beyond registration and support. The social network feature deliberately compiles contact lists and photos, and the policy does not list this feature as an exception.
